title: haven: keyMaterial for a user of this hub does not check the requester's canAddParticipant; for another provider's user it does
description: Haven fdce222. key_material_proxy.rs key_material_route (L47-90): a target on another provider is forwarded only for a participant whose role holds canAddParticipant (DIV-5: 'as mimid does'), else noConsent. For a local target (KeyMaterialRoute::Local) http.rs key_material_wire calls serve_key_material_for, which checks consent only (lib.rs keypackage_access L803-830), not the requester's role. Seen 2026-11-17 (local namespace run, mimid-chat 58d2734): with /roles no-add (member role without canAddParticipant), keyMaterial for mimi://haven.localhost/u/erin answered success and claimed a KeyPackage; the hub then refused the Commit (tracked room: notAllowed 'the proposer's role does not authorize the change'). mimid answers noConsent at keyMaterial for the same role (hub/key_material.rs, log 'keyMaterial refused by room policy ... role 2 does not hold capability 0x0000'). protocol-07 §5.2 has no rule either way, so not a spec violation; the cost is a KeyPackage used up by a requester who cannot add. Mention only with Mark's OK.
